arcs.title: The New Registry
arcs.summary: Day 3: Quoyne is conducting a thorough inquiry. Goblins have provided an unsolicited three-sentence character reference for Jersey (filed under Supporting Documentation, Compelling), noting he resolved a tension between two Senior Council members by settling across both their laps. A competing nomination from Magical Accidents (an enchanted kettle) is thinner and lacks goblin endorsement. Day 4 (resolution): Quoyne should rule in Jersey's favour with suitable ceremony — a second divider placed on the shelf, the entry formally inscribed, and some warm specific detail about what the registry entry actually says. The kettle nomination can be noted sympathetically and deferred, or given an honourable mention. Resolve warmly and with quiet dignity befitting both Quoyne and Jersey.
